children.name: Astelia
children.description: Astelia — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Astelia alpina R.Br.
children.description: Astelia alpina called pineapple grass, silver astelia, or perching lily is a commonly found species in alpine and subalpine areas of Tasmania and the Australian Alps.

children.name: Astelia argyrocoma A.Heller ex Skottsb.
children.description: Astelia argyrocoma is a species of astelia endemic to the highlands of Kauaʻi in Hawaii, United States.

children.name: Astelia australiana  L.B.Moore
children.description: The native range of this species is Victoria. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Astelia banksii A.Cunn.
children.description: Astelia banksii is an evergreen silver-green plant from the beaches of New Zealand.

children.name: Astelia chathamica  L.B.Moore
children.description: Astelia chathamica, commonly known as the Chatham Islands kakaha, Moriori flax, or silver spear, is a species of flowering plant in the recently named family Asteliaceae.

children.name: Astelia fragrans Colenso
children.description: Astelia fragrans, commonly known as bush lily, bush flax or kakaha, is the most common Astelia species found in New Zealand.

children.name: Astelia graminea L.B.Moore
children.description: Astelia graminea is a species of plant, endemic to New Zealand.

children.name: Astelia grandis Hook.f. ex Kirk
children.description: The native range of this species is New Zealand. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Astelia hastata Colenso
children.description: Astelia hastata, commonly known as the kahakaha, widow maker, perching lily, and tank lily, is an epiphyte species endemic to New Zealand.

children.name: Astelia hemichrysa  Kunth
children.description: The native range of this species is Mauritius, Réunion. It is a perennial or epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Astelia linearis Hook.f.
children.description: The native range of this species is New Zealand (incl. Stewart I.). It is a perennial and grows primarily in the subalpine or subarctic biome.

children.name: Astelia menziesiana Sm.
children.description: Astelia menziesiana is a species of plant in the family Asteliaceae that is endemic to the state of Hawaii in the United States.

children.name: Astelia pumila  Gaudich.

children.name: Astelia rapensis Skottsb.
children.description: The native range of this species is Tubuai Is. (Rapa Iti). It is a perennial and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Neoastelia

children.name: Neoastelia spectabilis J.B.Williams
children.description: Neoastelia  is a genus of plants in the family Asteliaceae containing the single species Neoastelia spectabilis, commonly known as the silver sword lily, that is endemic to a small area on the Northern Tablelands of New South Wales, Australia. It is a species of herb with long, linear leaves and large groups of whitish flowers, followed by spherical, pale green berries.
